patterns.rule: Every color token is an HSL triplet stored as a bare CSS custom property and consumed through hsl(var(--name)) — never a hex literal in a component.

Spacing between stacked interactive rows (a list item, a table row, a form field) stays tight — 0.5rem or less between elements — so more state is visible per screen without scrolling, the opposite of a marketing page's generous whitespace.

Text size for data and controls stays at or below the base size (14px/0.875rem); only the page's own title uses a larger size, so a screen full of rows and fields does not compete with the content it displays.
Interactive controls (button, input, select, checkbox) always render with a visible border or fill and a border-radius from the radius scale — never the unstyled browser default control.
Radius stays small (4px or less) across every control, matching the dense, function-first feel — a large rounded corner reads as a marketing site, not a tool.
